jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

As a Data Analyst at ARKET, you will play a key role in understanding customer behaviour and digital performance across arket.com. By turning data into actionable insights, you will help teams make better commercial decisions, improve customer experiences and identify new growth opportunities.

In this role, you will work across analytics, experimentation and digital performance, partnering closely with stakeholders throughout the business.

You will:

* Analyse customer, commercial and digital performance data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Drive insights that support business decisions across Digital CX and Sales, Merchandising and Marketing.
* Own the expirimentaion road map and drive A/B testing and experimentation initiatives to optimise customer journeys and conversion.
* Be the voice of the customer by suggesting actions based on NPS/Customer feedback findings
* Build dashboards, performance reporting and self-service insights that increase data visibility across teams.
* Ensure high-quality measurement and tracking by partnering with Product and Development teams.

Who you'll work with

You will be part of ARKET's digital organisation and collaborate closely with colleagues across Digital CX and Sales, Merchandising, Marketing and Product. Working alongside Product Managers, Experience Designers, Developers and Data specialists, you will help shape how data and customer insights drive business decisions and improve the online customer experience.

 **Qualifications**

We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with commercial curiosity and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

You have:

* Experience working with web analytics, digital performance analysis or e-commerce analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), visual analytics tools and data visualisation tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or similar.
* Experience working with SQL and large datasets, preferably including BigQuery.
* Experience analysing customer behaviour and translating insights into business recommendations.
* Experience supporting experimentation, A/B testing or conversion optimisation initiatives.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Professional proficiency in English.

Behaviours based on our values

* Delivery & Execution: Ability to produce high-quality, accurate work, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines. You should also be able to demonstrate resilience under pressure.
* Problem Solving & Judgment: Ability to analyse issues logically, use data and evidence to guide decisions & anticipate and address issues before they arise.
* Communication: Able to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, you should be able to explain technical or complex points simply and keep stakeholders informed and updated.
* Collaboration: Ability to work constructively with other colleagues, share knowledge and support teammates. You should also be openminded and accept feedback professionally.
* Adaptable & Curious: You should be able to adjust to changing priorities, learns new tools and processes quickly and show curiosity and self-development

  
**Additional Information**

This is a full time temporary contract for 12 months based at our Head Office in Stockholm, Södermalm

If you feel this opportunity is exciting feel free to apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible, but no later than 18th October, 2026. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

We value collaboration and believe that great ideas thrive when we work closely together. Therefore, this role is primarily office-based, with four days per week at the office to foster teamwork and engagement. One day per week, you’ll have the flexibility to work remotely.

Please note this position is offered on a local contract, therefore you should have the legal right to work in Sweden before applying. Other candidates are welcome to register their interest, and we will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

WHO WE ARE

ARKET is a modern-day market for everyday life, bringing together clothing, design, food and ideas. With a modern Nordic perspective, shaped by closeness to nature, functionality and a clear sense of seasonality, our ambition is to inspire a simpler, more beautiful way of living. Available to a broad audience worldwide, we offer contemporary products that are made and selected with care, designed to be used, lived with and returned to over time.here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

We offer all our employees attractive benefits with broad development opportunities. All our employees receive a staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to this, Sweden-based colleagues also receive:

* 30 days holiday
* A collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance
* Wellness benefit 4000kr/year
* Benify Benefits Portal

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

We look forward to hearing from you

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
*A product-oriented banking and finance professional who understands both the commercial transaction and the accounting behind it, and can bridge Finance & Accounting with Product & Tech to create scalable system solutions.*

**Bank at core, innovation at heart**  
Nordiska is a bank offering a complete range of financial services, allowing us to tailor solutions to each customer while simultaneously enabling them to gain access to advanced financial technology. Part of our offering is our Embedded platform, enabling enterprise partners across Europe to seamlessly integrate financial services – including saving, lending, and payments – into innovative product offerings. Additionally, we provide corporate and real estate financing, as well as sustainable savings with a government-backed deposit guarantee.

To meet future demands, we continuously scale our modern technology platform, expand partner integrations, and accelerate product innovation to help shape the future of financial services.

**Working at Nordiska**

Since our founding, we have been committed to driving innovation and creating meaningful impact. We work towards an ambitious vision and goals, backed up by our history of successfully delivering high-quality results and sustainable growth.

Historically and going forward, the people working at Nordiska are what enables our success. We balance our professional environment with an entrepreneurial mindset, always acting with honesty and responsibility, to build long-term trust among customers, partners and employees.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a person to join our Product organisation and operate in the intersection between Finance, Accounting, Banking Products and Technology.

The role will act as an important link between Finance & Accounting and Product & Tech, with a particular focus on how banking products and business events are represented, processed and accounted for across our systems.

You will need to understand the full business flow behind a financial transaction – for example how a card purchase, loan disbursement, repayment, interest accrual or deposit moves through our banking platform – and translate that into robust system and accounting requirements.

This is therefore not a traditional accounting role. We are looking for someone who combines a solid understanding of accounting with strong systems thinking and an understanding of banking products and processes.

**In the role, you will**

* Act as the link between Finance & Accounting and Product & Tech when developing and improving financial and banking processes.

* Understand end-to-end business flows and translate them into system and accounting requirements.

* Define how different business events should be represented and accounted for across the banking platform, financial systems and General Ledger.

* Work with transaction and accounting flows related to areas such as cards, loans and credits, savings and deposits, payments, interest and fees, repayments, settlement and reconciliation.

* Ensure that accounting logic implemented in our systems accurately reflects both the underlying business event and requirements from Finance.

* Map and document business processes, transaction flows and accounting flows.

* Translate Finance and Accounting requirements into clear specifications for Product and Engineering.

* Participate in development and implementation of new banking products and functionality from an accounting and financial systems perspective.

* Identify gaps, manual processes and reconciliation issues and drive improvements and increased automation.

* Support the design of integrations and data flows between Core Banking, payment systems, product systems and financial/accounting systems.

* Contribute to scalable financial processes as products, transaction volumes and the organisation grow.

**Your Professional Profile**  
We are looking for an analytical and structured professional with a strong understanding of accounting and financial flows, combined with experience in banking and financial systems. You enjoy exploring complex business flows, investigating discrepancies and translating Finance and Accounting needs into clear requirements. You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and combine attention to detail with a broader business perspective.

**We believe that you have**

* You have a BSc or MSc in Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent, preferably with an Accounting focus.
* You understand accounting principles, financial flows and how business events translate into accounting entries and reporting.
* You have experience with Core Banking Systems or transaction-heavy financial platforms, as well as ERP systems such as NetSuite.
* You understand how banking systems handle transactions, balances, interest, fees and accounting events.
* You have experience with banking products such as cards, lending, savings, or payments.
* You are analytical and structured, able to analyse end-to-end flows, investigate discrepancies and translate Finance and Accounting needs into business and system requirements.
* You collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and communicate complex concepts clearly.

**It is meritorious if you have**

* Experience with Mambu or another modern Core Banking Platform.

* Experience from a digital bank, fintech, consumer finance company or specialist bank.

* Experience with reconciliation, settlement and General Ledger integrations.

* Experience working closely with software engineering teams.

**Application**

If you’re looking to join a growth-driven environment that pairs innovation with profitability and reliability, welcome to Nordiska. We look forward to receiving your application.

We review and interview continuously, with background checks as part of the final stage of our process. For questions about the role and or more information, you are warmly welc

jobs.title: Industrial Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**Role Description**
--------------------

We are looking for a motivated and curious Marketing Intern to join our Industrial marketing team for four months. This is an exciting opportunity for a student who wants to gain real-world experience in B2B marketing while working with a global brand.

As an intern, you will support the planning, execution, and analysis of marketing activities that help promote our products and solutions across a variety of industrial sectors. You will work closely with marketing, sales, and product teams and gain exposure to digital marketing, content creation, campaign management, event support, customer insights, and analytics.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both creativity and data-driven decision-making and wants to develop a broad marketing skill set in a fast-paced international environment. While you'll have opportunities to contribute to content, social media, campaigns, and events, you'll also gain valuable experience in the behind-the-scenes activities that drive business results.

We're looking for someone who is curious, proactive, and hands-on to support everything from campaign execution and reporting to data analysis, planning, and lead management.

**Key Success Factors**

* Strong written communication skills
* Organized and dependable
* Analytical mindset
* Self-starter attitude
* Comfortable asking questions and learning quickly
* Collaborative and positive team player

**Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, Media Studies, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
* Interest in digital marketing, social media, analytics, and content development.

**Timeline**

No hard timeline, the aim it is to start this fall & winter and complete by the end of May 2027.

**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------

Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!

Contact:

Matthew Hartman, Digital Marketing Strategist, matthew.hartman@volvo.com

Last application date: October 27

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

**Who we are and what we believe in**  
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

**Volvo Penta**, a world-leading supplier of engines and complete drive systems for marine and industrial applications, you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who works with passion, trust each other and embraces change to stay ahead. We make our customers win.

jobs.title: Quantitative analyst for Automated Trading of the short-term US power market
jobs.description:
**Quote**
---------

You will combine quantitative research, machine learning, and software engineering to uncover market inefficiencies and turn them into profitable trading strategies.

**Here’s what the job entails**
-------------------------------

IIn the role, you will tackle challenging quantitative problems and develop fully automated, machine learning-driven trading strategies for the US short-term power market that have a direct impact on trading performance.

Your key responsibilities include:

* designing, developing, and deploying machine learning-driven trading strategies using Python and modern machine learning/deep learning frameworks
* transforming large-scale and high-dimensional datasets into actionable trading signals and predictive models
* continuously improving existing models, infrastructure, and research processes to maintain a competitive edge
* collaborating closely with our US traders and analysts to translate market insights into scalable quantitative solutions
* staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning, deep learning, and quantitative finance, and taking full ownership of bringing new ideas into production

**Meet your team**
------------------

You will join our Short-term Automated Trading team, where we develop and operate algorithmic trading strategies in the European electricity markets by applying advanced quantitative methods, machine learning, and automation to make better trading decisions.

We are a team of highly motivated specialists with backgrounds in quantitative finance, mathematics, physics, computer science, and machine learning. We challenge each other's thinking, move quickly from idea to implementation, and share an ambition to build better models and make better trading decisions. We value intellectual curiosity, honest feedback, and rigorous thinking.

**But enough about us… over to you!**
-------------------------------------

You’ll work deeply with quantitative modelling and machine learning in a fast-moving domain, so you enjoy tackling complex quantitative challenges and turning ideas into measurable outcomes. You are driven by ownership, excellence, and the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled colleagues.

We also imagine that you:

* hold an MSc or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, physics, or a related field
* are an advanced Python developer with experience building robust, production-quality code
* have extensive experience with machine learning techniques and frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
* keep up with the latest innovation in machine learning and deep learning, and enjoy turning cutting-edge research into practical solutions that deliver measurable value

Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role. We welcome various levels of experience from a highly analytical environment and will tailor the role to your profile.

**We’ll take good care of you**
-------------------------------

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

**Shape your development** tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

**100+ yearly events** from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

**Global career paths** as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

**Flexible work life** adjustable hours, part-time options & up to 2 work from home days/week

**Fuel Fridays** one paid Friday off every month (July and December excluded)

**Top-tier parental leave** up to 26 weeks paid, pension during leave & post-leave support

**Unlimited paid child's sick days** because family comes first

**Extra time off** 5 additional days on top of your 5 weeks

**Senior days** extra time off if you’re 55+

**Attractive package** 10% pension, health insurance, bonus scheme & more

**Share savings** the option to join Equinor’s attractive share programme

**Home setup covered** paid internet, phone & IT gear

**Free tickets & discounts** culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

**Organic meals** light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

**Barista café** high-quality coffee, always on us

**On-site wellness** state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

**HQ in the heart of Aarhus** with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Category: Quality

Location:
Bagsværd, Capital Region of Denmark, DK

**Department:** Complaint Projects & Digital Products, Enterprise IT & Quality

**Location:** Bagsværd, Denmark

  

**Your impact begins here**

As AI & PowerBI Developer, you will bring AI and PowerBI into the daily work of the business. You will design, build and maintain analytics and automation that turn real business needs into clear insights and more efficient processes. Working hands-on with data and close to the people who use your work, you will introduce new AI technologies, help colleagues make informed, data-driven decisions and gain broad exposure to Novo Nordisk’s product portfolio.

  

**What you’ll bring**

You are self-sufficient and enjoy creating and driving data-centric projects. You’ll bring:

* An MSc in IT, Data Analytics, Software Engineering or a related field.
* At least 2 years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience with Python, SQL and PowerBI development.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to share technical knowledge with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* A collaborative mindset and openness to working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
* Flexibility and adaptability, with the ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies.

**Useful, but not essential:**

* Familiarity with using AI for development, such as MCPs, skills and context engineering.
  

**What you’ll do**

You will work hands-on with data to design, build and maintain BI and AI solutions that support daily business. Close partnership with end users and management will shape how you understand needs, test what you build and keep refining it.

* Build, deploy and maintain efficient, intuitive BI and AI solutions in line with quality standards.
* Manage existing PowerBI and generative-AI solutions to keep them performing at their best.
* Take ownership of opportunities to improve process efficiency through AI or BI automation.
* Follow developments in the AI space and bring new technology into your solutions where it adds value.
* Listen to the business, identify needs, visualise data and support data-driven processes and decision-making.
* Navigate complex business domains and organisational structures to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping them get real value from business intelligence and AI.
  

**Who you’ll work with**

In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the Novo Nordisk value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

You will join the Complaint Projects & Digital Products team, which supports the business in executing strategic projects and implementing digital products. Your role stands out because you will introduce new technologies, including AI, and make sure the team has the assets it needs to produce valuable insights and support informed, data-driven decisions.

You will report to the Associate Director of Complaint Projects & Digital Products, based in Bagsværd, and work closely with managers and colleagues across departments. Your closest partners will be the end users and management who rely on your work, and together you will move quickly from identifying a need to testing and refining what works.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will gain broad exposure to Novo Nordisk’s product portfolio and work with diverse stakeholders across the organisation. You will have room to bring forward new AI technologies, make your voice heard and contribute your expertise to how the business uses data.

You will be trusted to take ownership of your work and supported to grow as you learn and apply new technologies on the job. As Novo Nordisk upskills its workforce to advance AI as a main driver for innovation, you will be part of putting that ambition into practice, day to day.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn data and AI into progress the business can use every day, apply for the AI & PowerBI Developer role by 23 October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact acur@novonordisk.com

  

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.title: Social Media & Performance Marketing Intern
jobs.description:
**Are you curious about what makes content perform on social media? Do you want hands-on experience with content, community and digital marketing in an international fashion brand?**

PIECES is looking for a curious and proactive intern to join our Performance Marketing team in January 2027. You will work hands-on with our social media channels while learning how content, consumer behaviour and performance insights come together.

**YOUR TEAM**  
You will become part of our Performance Marketing team, working across paid social, influencer marketing, content and community. We put the consumer first and continuously test, learn and optimise how we engage with our audience across digital channels.

As an intern, you will work closely with the team on both daily activities and new initiatives, giving you insight into different areas of digital marketing.

**YOUR ROLE**  
You will support our day-to-day social media activities and help us create relevant content and interactions across our channels. You will also get the opportunity to follow performance and learn how insights can be used to improve future content.

Your key tasks will include:

* Scheduling and publishing content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and Pinterest
* Writing social copy and engaging with our community across channels
* Supporting influencer collaborations, including gifting, coordination and follow-up
* Assisting with content creation, product tagging and social commerce
* Identifying relevant trends, creators and formats, and following content performance to turn insights into learnings

**YOUR BENEFITS**  
During your internship, you will gain:

* Hands-on experience with social media, influencer marketing and performance marketing
* Practical experience with content, community management and consumer behaviour
* Insight into how performance data can inform content and digital marketing decisions
* Experience working with a test-and-learn approach across different digital channels
* Responsibility for your own tasks while working closely with colleagues across the team

**YOUR PROFILE**  
You are curious about digital marketing and interested in understanding both the creative and analytical sides of social media. You enjoy keeping track of details, contributing ideas and learning by getting involved in the work.

We imagine that you:

* Are studying marketing, e-commerce, communication or a related field
* Write confidently in English
* Work in a structured and detail-oriented way and take initiative in your tasks
* Have an interest in social media, digital trends, fashion and branding
* Enjoy working with both creative content and performance insights

Previous experience with social media or digital marketing is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**WE ARE LOOKING FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU**  
If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Digital Marketing Responsible, Charlotte Ascanius at +45 30 85 29 61.

Please upload your CV as soon as possible and no later than 1 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the posting once we have found the right match.

Please also include a short cover letter explaining your motivation for applying for the internship.

**Location:** Aarhus, Denmark  
**Expected starting date:** January 2027  
**Internship duration:** 4-5 months

**ABOUT PIECES**  
*Easy to wear – easy to love*

*PIECES designs everyday standout products for young-at-heart fashion followers. Our approach is centred around current trends, and we believe in the power of vibrant colours and relevant designs. Each collection is influenced by the latest fashion, and we especially focus on garment-fit, simple yet quality fabrics, and adding as many certified and branded fibres as possible. Piece by piece, we are young at heart, intuitively curious and vibrant to the core.*

*PIECES is a Danish apparel and accessory brand located in Aarhus. It was established in 2003 as part of the BESTSELLER group, a Danish family-owned fashion company. As a brand, PIECES has evolved and grown greatly over the past years. Coming from an accessory-focused core, we constantly push to grow with our potential.*

*For more information, please go to www.pieces.com, @piecesofficial or www.bestseller.com*
